$comment: PocketAI backend runtime settings (Phase 5). All paths are RELATIVE to the PocketAI root so the USB drive letter can change. The model server connection lives in config/model.json (single source of truth for llama.cpp).

backend.host_note: Loopback only, enforced at startup. PocketAI never listens on the network.

chat.max_message_chars_note: Hard cap on a single user message (request validation). ~2000 tokens.
chat.enable_thinking_note: Qwen3.5 is a thinking model. Live smoke test (Phase 5): thinking ON spent the full 1536-token budget on reasoning in ~167s and returned no visible answer; thinking OFF answered the same query in ~12s. Default OFF for 8GB-class hardware; set true to trade latency for deeper reasoning.

rag.max_upload_mb_note: Per-file upload cap. Files are stored under rag/uploads/<doc_id>/ and nowhere else; PocketAI never scans folders or drives.
rag.chat_context_max_chars_note: Max chars of retrieved excerpts injected into the chat system prompt (~1000 tokens). Keeps RAG inside the SAFE-profile context budget.
rag.retrieval_note: BM25 lexical retrieval (Option B). Embeddings (Option A) are disabled on 8GB targets: they would need a second llama-server process (~300-500MB extra RAM). See rag/embeddings/base.py.

image.max_upload_mb_note: Per-image cap (clipboard/upload). Screenshots are usually 0.5-3 MB; 10 MB leaves headroom without risking 8GB RAM.
image.max_dimension_note: Longest side; larger images are downscaled before OCR to bound memory and OCR time.
image.ocr_language_note: Offline OCR engine (portable Tesseract, bundled). No network, no cloud. The local Qwen model is text-only, so images become OCR text the supervisor reasons about.
image.max_pixels_note: Pillow decompression-bomb guard: beyond this the image is rejected, not decoded into RAM. Normal screenshots are far below this and are downscaled instead.

security.developer_mode_note: Off by default. When true, the GET /skills endpoint exposes the internal skill registry for debugging. Normal users never need it; the dashboard does not call it.
security.notes: Localhost binding only; no arbitrary command execution anywhere in the backend; skill files are only read from the skills_dir below the PocketAI root; the model API key from model.json is never returned by any endpoint.
